svg.text: chicken-poses. Side view, 250 px = 1 m. One cell = one animation; the pose is the key frame that sells it. Timings are from the GDD.
jerks side to side, glasses glint.
Run 5 m/s. Body leans 12 deg, head
Arc up to 10 m, 25 dmg, knockdown.
Gun 0.9 m: longer than she is. Wing
tucks it, body leans back from weight.
Recoil kicks her back 0.3 m, glasses
the pump, red shell flies out.
Kneels, digs in the bag. Game does
NOT pause - pose must look exposed.
Flops on her back, feet up, stars
spin. Then cut to the food screen.
